source_refs.note: Plastic Deformation: a main subheading of 5.5 Elastic deformation, plastic deformation and elastic limit, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 98-98.

blocks.text: Agar stress yield stress (elastic limit) se aage barhaya jaye to specimen (test wala tukra) hamesha ke liye badal jata hai: stress hatane ke baad bhi apni asal shakal ya size mein wapas nahi aata. Is behaviour ko plasticity kehte hain. Curve ka B se C tak hissa plasticity ka hai. Point C material ki ultimate tensile strength (UTS) σᵤ hai: woh sab se zyada stress jo material bardasht kar sakta hai; ise material ki nominal strength (asal strength) bhi keh sakte hain. Point C paar hone ke baad material point D par toot jata hai; D par stress fracture stress (σf) hai.
